commitResults.messageBody:
To move the codebase to fit ScamBook's requirements, Person now do not have
addresses, and optional phone and emails.

At the moment, the add command can only add people with a name,
while their phone and email will be null. This will be for a future commit.

Additionally, implemented the functionality for inputPatterns & tokens,
which will streamline adding new commands

commitResults.messageTitle: fix: fixed checkstyle violations & removed address from various test function
commitResults.messageBody:
Various test functions called functions with withAddress() and getAddress()
that were removed, leading to gradlew not being able to compile all files.
The test functions now do not have any references to address

Additionally, several checkstyle violations existed, and those were fixed.

Finally, add javadocs documentation for some functions in InputPattern & Token

Now, InputPatterns are specififed in terms of their tokens, and their parmeters.
The parameters all come after the tokens.

Currently, the add command supports -email and -phone optional parameters
